longDescription: Turn your Ulanzi D200X into a context-aware CAD console for FreeCAD (0.21, 1.0, and 1.1+) on macOS and Windows. Automatically syncs keys and icons per workbench (Part Design, Sketcher, Part, Core), supports smart multi-page navigation with live dot indicators, switches to Constraints on Sketcher geometry selection, and opens an automatic Numpad on numeric dialogs. Runs 100% locally via 127.0.0.1 with a 1-click Bridge installer.
